note: Raises an alternative framing before building on the concept.
turn: A dashboard would show the data, but I think the problem you described is that nobody notices when a run fails — and a dashboard only helps someone who is already looking. An alert on failure would cover the case you named; a dashboard covers the case where you go looking. Which is the one that bit you?
context: We should build a dashboard so the team can see build health at a glance.
